facts.claim: St. Joseph's College in Bangalore taught up to the B.A. standard and had a staff of ten priests and twenty other masters.
facts.quote: most important of the former being St. Joseph's College at Bangalore, teaching up to the B.A. standard, with a staff of ten priests and twenty other masters.

facts.claim: The Catholic population of Mysore was 26,518 according to the census of 1891.
facts.quote: The Catholic population of Mysore, according to the census of 1891, is 26,518, of whom five per cent, are Europeans, six per cent. Eurasians, and the remainder natives.
